retrievalProfile.description: A vertical mirrored layout featuring ultra-condensed, stylized display type with a color-inverted reflection over a background of horizontal scan lines.

recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical vertical composition where a row of highly stylized, ultra-condensed black letters is mirrored below in a vibrant red, set against a background of thin horizontal lines that transition from warm peach to cool grey.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry across a central horizontal axis
High contrast between black upper text and red lower reflection
Repetitive horizontal line pattern creating a rhythmic texture
coreInvariants: Thin white or light-colored outlines on all glyphs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The text occupies approximately 80% of the vertical frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal axis where the black and red letters meet.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical movement from the top black text down to the red reflection, guided by the elongated strokes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space between letters, creating a dense, wall-like typographic effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Peach-to-grey gradient background with horizontal lines.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black for the primary top text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for the mirrored bottom text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red reflection contrasting with the neutral black and muted background tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-condensed slab serif with psychedelic curves
letterConstructionRules: Consistent thin white outline around every character
Negative space within characters (like 'O' and 'B') is extremely narrow
characterSpecificRedesigns: O is a narrow vertical pill shape
W features deep, sharp valleys and tall outer peaks
E has short horizontal bars and a curved spine
B has two very small, circular counters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both primary and reflected elements to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn curves and heavy weight.
Provides the structural height and weight required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a background consisting of thin, evenly spaced horizontal lines. The background should have a vertical gradient transitioning from a warm peach at the top to a muted grey-green at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom ultra-condensed psychedelic lettering in the top half in solid black with a thin white outline. Mirror this text exactly in the bottom half, changing the fill color to a vibrant orange-red while keeping the white outline.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly mirrored across the horizontal center?
Are the letterforms extremely tall and narrow?
Does every letter have a thin white outline?
Is the background composed of fine horizontal lines?

mustRedesign: Exact letter shapes that match proprietary fonts

avoid: Inconsistent line weights in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of mirrored glyphs
Ensure background lines are strictly horizontal
Verify the presence of the thin white outline on all text
Confirm the color transition from peach to grey in the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Take [Ultra-Condensed Psychedelic Type], apply [Thin White Outline], place over [Horizontal Line Gradient], and [Mirror Vertically] with [Color Inversion].
